name: samples only from the nucleus
test:
samples = [top_p_sample([3.0, 2.0, 1.0, 0.0], 0.8) for _ in range(200)]
assert set(samples) == {0, 1}
assert all(isinstance(token_id, int) for token_id in samples)
print('ok')

name: returns original token indexes
single-token nucleus is deterministic
test:
samples = [top_p_sample([10.0, 0.0, 0.0], 0.5) for _ in range(20)]
assert samples == [0] * 20
print('ok')

name: top_p one samples the full distribution
temperature changes the nucleus
test:
cold = [top_p_sample([2.0, 0.0], 0.8, temperature=1.0) for _ in range(20)]
hot = [top_p_sample([2.0, 0.0], 0.8, temperature=2.0) for _ in range(200)]
assert cold == [0] * 20
assert set(hot) == {0, 1}
print('ok')
